sections.section: ORDER - Martial Law Order 1962 (Zone B) No. 125
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
By
MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ZONE `B'
No. 125
[6th May 1962, Gazette of West Pakistan, Extraordinary, 11th May 1962]
Whereas it is expedient in the
public interest to provide for measures to control the acquisition of land,
constructions of all descriptions and costs and rents thereof within the Lahore
Cantonment boundaries (hereinafter referred to as the said boundaries).
Therefore, I, Lt.-General
Bakhtiar Rana, SQA, MC, ADC, Martial Law Administrator, Zone `B', hereby order
as under :
(1) No civilian person, company
or association will be allowed to reside or acquire land within the said
boundaries under any terms or con ditions or construct any building without the
prior permission and approval of the General Officer Commanding 10 Division.
The rent charges of the existing houses and those that may be constructed in
future will be assessed according to
the rules to be laid down by General Officer Commanding 10 Division.
(2) Any person who contravenes or
attempts to contravene or abets the contravention of any order issued in
pursuance of this Order shall be liable to be punished under C.M.L.A Regulation
No. 16 (a).
(3) No provision of this Order
shall be called in question in any Court including the High Court and the
Supreme Court. No suit or legal proceedings shall lie against any person or
authority in respect of anything which is in good faith done or intended to be
done in pursuance of this Order.
sections.punishment: shall be liable to be punished under C.
